title: Raftload
description: Changes the models of Boatload boats generated by Every Compat to match their corresponding boat.
body:
**Requires Entity Model Features, Entity Texture Features, and any compatible mods.**

This resource pack changes the models and textures of supported Boats generated by [Every Compat](https://modrinth.com/mod/every-compat) to adhere to the original wood type's boat.

Supported mods as of currently:
- [Alex's Caves](https://modrinth.com/mod/alexs-caves)
- [Boatload](https://modrinth.com/mod/Boatload) (no large boats yet)
- [Spawn](https://modrinth.com/mod/spawn-mod)
- [Supplementaries](https://modrinth.com/mod/supplementaries) (only boats with base model)

NOTES:
- Entities riding Rafts will sink into it. I don't think there's a way to fix that with just a resource pack.
- Cannon Boats do not have custom models, as EMF does not generate them.
- Large Boats do not have custom models yet, they may or may not be included in a future version.

If you have a suggestion, open an issue please :P
